versions.content: Execution Management shall support State Management func- tionality. Status: DRAFT Description: Execution Management shall provide an interface to State Management to request a change in Function Group State . Rationale: To support the starting and stopping of Processes based on declared Function Group State dependencies, Execution Management provides an interface to request Function Group State (including Machine State ) changes by the State Management fuctional cluster. In response to state change requests, Execution Management ensures that only the required set of application Processes are running in any given operation conditions and therefore platform resources are saved for relevant Processes . Dependencies: – Use Case: Provide a mechanism to define modes of operation of the Machine . Supporting Material: –
